The '''Morish''' were a short, furry [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a secret communications center was established in [[Old Recluse's cave|a cave]] on Morishim; after the Empire pulled out, a Morish known as the [[Old Recluse]] found the abandoned communications link, and used its newsfeeds to fool others into believing he had [[Fortune teller/Legends|clairvoyant]] abilities. Other Morish, meanwhile, plied their wares at a local marketplace.

==Biology and appearance==
The Morish were diminutive in stature, and were covered in fur. The [[Species/Legends|species]] also featured [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Society and culture==
The Morish spoke the [[Morish language]], and also used hand signs for purposes such as haggling. At least [[Old Recluse|one]] Morish also spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] at an expert level.<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Morish in the galaxy==
As of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a [[Unidentified wk'ou seller|female Morish]] ran a produce stall at a local marketplace on Morishim; her wares included the [[wk'ou melon]]. At the same marketplace, [[Unidentified Morish informant|an elderly Morish]] offered information from his own stall, while another elderly Morish, the Old Recluse, inhabited [[Old Recluse's cave|a cave]] that contained an Imperial monitoring station.<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Morish species first appeared in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and released in [[1997]].<ref name="SpecPast" />
